producedBy.contractUniverse: crate::inference_runtime::memory_contract_surface_registry() — the LINKED MLX bundle's weights-free memory-contract surfaces

enumeratedInputs.why: The synthesis floor is a pure function of MemoryProviderContract::asset_facts, and every weights-free contract builder in the pinned inference bundle injects zeros by contract. No CPU lane can resolve real asset facts and no committed table backfills them, so they are ENUMERATED here — the same posture sc-19049 took for sequentialCapable — rather than invented. These rows characterize the mechanism over the shipped contract structures; they are NOT admission decisions for any shipped route on a real machine.
